catalogue_source: games/catalogue.py (Python list; no DB table for the catalogue)

page_loader.description: templates/games/play.html loads, all with defer, in this order: the shared shell, (samaru-days only) qrcode + arcade-lan, then each dep from catalogue extra.deps (or the bundle), then level packs the viewer may open (level <= viewer max_level), then the game entry script. A name containing "/" is a static path + ".js"; otherwise static/js/games/<name>.js.
stage_data_attributes: data-gm-config (JSON page_config: hashed cheats, rules, hero meta)

games.title: Momentum Cup
games.description: Big-headed scientists play head-football in seven arenas, with superpowers, a roaring crowd and a six-round cup against Count Entropy.

games.controls: A/D move · double-tap a direction to dash (or Shift) · W jump (hold for height) · S kick · Q lob · E power · hold ←/→ to aim

games.title: Wavefront
games.description: Fight Count Entropy's machines across eight stages with weapons made of light: every one follows a real wave law.
games.gameplay_loop: Run and aim, tune your frequency, pick the right wave weapon, cross your polariser to his beams, beat the boss.

Polarisation and Malus's law, I = I₀cos²θ
